english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a clothing pocket when the context makes clear that it is not a bag.

examples.english: I put the keys in my trouser pocket.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 so2 si4 fong3 zo2 jap6 fu3 doi2

english.note: Use this when the packet is specifically a flexible bag, such as a crisp packet.

examples.english: Don't throw the crisp packet around after eating.
examples.traditional: 食完薯片唔好亂掉個袋。
examples.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 syu4 pin2 m4 hou2 lyun6 diu6 go3 doi2
